scope: Local verification only, on the feature/bq2-pipeline-improvements branch. Nothing was deployed to or run in AWS.

environment.spark: public.ecr.aws/glue/aws-glue-libs pinned image (pyspark 3.5.2), spark-submit --master local[8] --driver-memory 12g, Docker memory limit 15 GB
environment.pandas: laptop, Python 3.12, bda_pipeline.network via parquet_batches (200,000-row batches)

curation.note: Behaviour features skipped: the network job does not read them, and they are the slowest curation phase.

export_check.note: About 2.7x the linear scale-up of the 23.5 s HI-Small figure; well inside the 60-minute export limit and the 32 GB ml.m5.2xlarge.

results.independence: Thresholds and ranking were chosen on HI-Small; HI-Medium was not used to tune anything, so these rates are an out-of-sample check.
